problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.

diagnosis.diagnosis: The laptop is likely using cached old credentials from before the password change, preventing it from connecting to the Wi-Fi with the new password. The phone may have updated credentials automatically.
recommended_steps: Forget the eduroam network in Windows Settings > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks.
Reconnect to eduroam and enter the new password when prompted.
Check if your university account is active and has no login restrictions.
Verify campus Wi-Fi is operational (check university IT status pages for outages).
